## Checklist

- [ ] PR title uses Conventional Commits (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `test:` / `chore:`)
- [ ] `bun run ci` passes (Biome)
- [ ] `bun test` passes
- [ ] If routes changed: updated `swagger.js` annotations and ran `bun run sync-docs`
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
